compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Evaluating a Pass-1 change on Sonnet when production runs Opus (or vice versa) confounds the measurement: prior work showed Sonnet degrades past ~3 criteria per turn while Opus is flat, so a delta could be the model, not the change. Two further hazards: the production model classes (`rebar.toml` `[llm.model_classes]`: frontier = `bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8`, standard = `bedrock:…claude-sonnet-4-6`) carry an Anthropic-direct fallback, and `_intersect_capabilities` (`src/rebar/llm/runner_support.py`) collapses a mixed chain's `prompt_cache_style` to `none` — which is why cache reads dropped to zero on 2026-08-12 and review cost roughly doubled. An eval run that silently fell back to Anthropic would both break the "Bedrock only" requirement and lose caching.

## Approach

Build `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/parity.py` and wire it into every tier:

- **Pinned targets**: the harness resolves the model for each pass from the production class but requires the resolved id to be a Bedrock id and drops any fallback candidate (homogeneous single-provider chain). It refuses to start when the resolved id differs from the corpus baseline's `provider_provenance.ran_model` for that pass, unless `--allow-model-change` is passed, in which case the run is labelled `model-change` and can never be diffed against a baseline with a different id.
- **Result stamping**: every result row carries `{pass: model_id}`; `report.py` refuses to diff two result sets whose per-pass ids differ.
- **Caching check**: after each run, assert from the run's usage-log rows that `cache_read_tokens > 0` on at least one call after the first; the report states cached vs uncached and the ledger flags uncached runs (they cost ~2× and should be investigated before the next run).
- No production config is changed by this ticket; the homogeneous chain is composed in-process for eval runs only.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/parity.py` (new); hooks in `tier1.py`, `tier2.py`, `report.py`
- `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_parity.py` (new)

## Testing

Unit: a config whose frontier class resolves to an Anthropic id is refused; a mixed chain is reduced to its Bedrock candidate; diffing results with different Pass-2 model ids raises; a usage-log fixture with zero cache reads marks the run uncached. Live check happens as part of the Tier-1 reproduction run.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every Tier-1/Tier-2 result and ledger row carries Bedrock model ids equal to the production class for that pass; checked by the ledger after commissioning.
- [ ] A diff between result sets with differing per-pass model ids is refused; checked by a unit test.
- [ ] The Tier-1 reproduction run shows `cache_read_tokens > 0`; checked from its usage-log rows and stated in its report.
- [ ] Unit tests pass in `make test`.
compiled_state.title: Model-parity guard: pin each eval pass to its production model on a homogeneous Bedrock chain; confirm prompt caching
